name: Slovakia — Slovak parties
intro: compare it with Slovak political parties
inclusion_note: The test includes the main national parties of Slovakia: those represented in the parliament (Národná rada) and those with a significant national following. Positions are the team's estimates and are open to review.
hemicycle_note: Seats in the parliament (Národná rada) after the 2023 election, arranged left to right. Approximate. 150 members. Parties shown without seats are included because they poll strongly.

PS.name: Progresívne Slovensko
PS.priorities: Rule of law, Deeper European integration, Education
PS.description: Progressive Slovakia, the liberal pro-European main opposition party, which leads recent polls.

Volt.name: Volt Slovensko
Volt.priorities: Deeper European integration, Climate action, Digital innovation, Democratic reform
Volt.description: National chapter of Volt Europa, the first pan-European party. All chapters share one programme: a federal and more democratic EU, evidence-based policy, a market economy with a strong welfare state, and the digital and climate transitions. Volt has the same positions in every country in this test.

Hlas.name: Hlas – sociálna demokracia
Hlas.priorities: Welfare state, Pensions and the elderly, Security and law and order
Hlas.description: Voice – Social Democracy, a Smer splinter now in government with it.

Smer.name: Smer – sociálna demokracia
Smer.priorities: Welfare state, National sovereignty, Diplomacy with Russia, no arms deliveries
Smer.description: Robert Fico's party, left-populist on the economy and nationalist on culture, opposed to military aid to Ukraine and in conflict with the EU over the rule of law.

SaS.name: Sloboda a Solidarita
SaS.priorities: Lower taxes, Less red tape, Education
SaS.description: Freedom and Solidarity, a classical-liberal party for low taxes and less bureaucracy.

KDH.name: Kresťanskodemokratické hnutie
KDH.priorities: Traditional family values, Christian values, Regions and rural services
KDH.description: Christian Democratic Movement, socially conservative and pro-European.

Slovensko.name: Hnutie Slovensko
Slovensko.description: Slovakia movement (formerly OĽaNO) of former prime minister Igor Matovič, an anti-corruption populist party.

SNS.name: Slovenská národná strana
SNS.priorities: National identity, National sovereignty, Christian values
SNS.description: Slovak National Party, a nationalist junior partner in Robert Fico's government.

Republika.name: Republika
Republika.priorities: National sovereignty, Diplomacy with Russia, no arms deliveries, Reducing immigration
Republika.description: Republic, a far-right party that narrowly missed parliament in 2023 but polls strongly since; it opposes aid to Ukraine and sanctions on Russia.
